text: Understanding databases is an important skill for anyone working with data. Databases store and organise information so it can be easily accessed and managed. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, which makes them suitable for structured data. NoSQL databases are more flexible and work well with unstructured or changing data. To get information from a database, you write queries. Good data modelling helps you design efficient tables and relationships. Indexes also improve performance by making searches faster. Choosing the right database and designing it well can save time and prevent problems later.
